desktop.ioDetail: Ephemeris ⓘ : data source and known limitations Known limitations The orientation is an approximate tidal lock keeping the near side towards Jupiter, with no libration. Accuracy Io's position is JPL Horizons' (ephemeris jup365_merged), reproduced by curve fits to within 0.0994 m at 1,001 checked dates 2010-2030. Horizons' own uncertainty is not stated in its output. Notes Geometric position about Jupiter's centre; no light-time. Valid 2010-2030, the span of the committed fits. Sources · 5 JPL Horizons API 1.2 (https://ssd.jpl.nasa.gov/api/horizons.api) state vectors about the Jupiter system ba
